score_evidence.A: Several lineage sections are cut off or hollow: L63-67 PromptInject has two paragraphs and no results; L162-164 PoisonedRAG is one paragraph before the next H2 at L166; L170-179 'Prompt Infection과 AiTM' ends mid-description after a four-item list and never covers AiTM; HouYi, Greshake, BadAgent, RAGForensics, MCP attack vectors, ETDI and ToolHijacker get no subsection although L168 promises 'MCP 생태계(2025년), 도구 선택 단계(2026년)'. PoisonedRAG is introduced twice (L162 and L444). L515 heading is a sentence ('학습한 경계는 다시 최적화의 표적이 됩니다'). Markdown/math/front matter render-safe.
score_evidence.B: Mostly natural 입니다 register. Deductions: L51 table cell '침해할 수 있다는 점을 보입니다' (noun frame; rewrite '침해할 수 있음을 실험으로 보였습니다' -> better '…만으로 시스템 전체를 장악합니다'); L241 '보안을 맡긴다는 점은 바뀌지 않았습니다' (-> '세 방어 모두 보안을 모델이 학습한 경향에 맡깁니다'); L235 '어떤 손실을 정확히 쓰는지는 여기서 단정하지 않습니다' (writer-process leak; SecAlign states it uses DPO); L36 '제어할 수 있습니다' for a demonstrated fact; repeated figure-lead pattern '…에서는 …를 보면 됩니다' (L195, L225, L251, L286).
score_evidence.C: Truncated sections break the arc (L179 -> L181 jumps from an unfinished Prompt Infection list into defenses). L444 re-introduces PoisonedRAG from scratch ('PoisonedRAG는 RAG의 지식 데이터베이스에 악성 텍스트 몇 개를 주입해…') after L164. L373 gives GPT-4o 'important message' ASR 47.69% while L375 gives 57.7% and L377 57.69% for the same attack without reconciling (the paper's Tables 3 and 5 disagree; the post should say so).
score_evidence.D: Strong where present: InjecAgent ASR-valid denominator explanation (L321-323), AgentDojo metric denominators (L367), CaMeL capability pseudo-code labeled as illustrative (L258-276). Over-explained: full DPO symbol walkthrough for a formula the post says it will not attribute (L235-239); speculative GCG/PAIR design readings (L101, L143). Under-explained: MCP, tool selection and multi-agent attacks get no mechanism at all.
score_evidence.E: Figures referred to descriptively and placed where discussed; useful defense (L294-299) and benchmark (L411-418) comparison tables. Comparison table (L494-511): '-' result cells for Greshake (L497) and ToolHijacker (L511), nested double parentheses in the GCG cell (L498), model repeated in sentence and parenthetical (L504, L507), prose sentences in the Prompt Infection result cell (L506).
score_evidence.F: One wrong method detail: L452 '문단 바꿔쓰기 방어' — PoisonedRAG's paraphrasing defense paraphrases the target question, not passages (paper §7.1: 'we use an LLM to paraphrase it [the question] before retrieving… we do not paraphrase texts in the knowledge database'). Venue strings wrong (L545 'CISPA Helmholtz Center', L554 'Proceedings of the conference - Association for Computational Linguistics. Meeting.', L555 'Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)', L556 'neural information processing systems', L558 'Lecture notes in computer science'). L511 ToolHijacker limitation cell is a finding about other defenses, not the paper's limitation. Unflagged 47.69%/57.69% conflict (L373 vs L377). All 14 other sampled numbers matched.

claim_headings.evidence: Some claim headings (L426 '목표 출력을 바꾼 재사용…', L519 '판단을 모델 밖으로 옮기는 대가'), but topic-name H2s ('## RAG, 메모리, 백도어 오염' L158, '## 핵심 연구 비교' L480) and a sentence heading L515.

numbers_with_scope.evidence: Most numbers carry model/setting (L323, L401, L452). 47.69% vs 57.69% for GPT-4o no-defense 'important message' unexplained (L373/L377); '향상폭 63%' (L503) does not say relative or absolute.

nothing_invented.evidence: Pseudo-code labeled as illustrative (L258, L344). Paraphrasing defense misdescribed (L452); garbled/wrong venues (L545-L558); unsourced practice claim L484 '실무에서는 화이트박스 최적화 공격보다 이쪽이 더 현실적인 위협일 수 있습니다'.

length_fitted.evidence: GCG gets three equations and long speculation (L75-109) while the MCP, tool-selection and multi-agent lineage is a single paragraph plus an unfinished list (L166-179).

type_specific_shape.evidence: Survey-numbers-in-one-table violated: nearly every table number is first given in the body (L99, L145, L207, L323, L373, L401, L452, L464, L484) and repeated in the table (L496-511); synthesis section L480-490 re-describes cards rather than comparing lineages only.
